zh.title: 華信立榮提停飛花蓮航線 民航局同意華信適度減班
zh.summary: 華信與立榮申請停飛花蓮航線，民航局同意華信減班，立榮案件評估中。
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月27日表示，針對華信航空提出暫停營運高雄至花蓮及台中至花蓮航線的申請，初步審查後請業者補充說明並考量地方需求。民航局指出，華信航空後續將採循序漸進方式處理，同意其在訂位狀況不佳時適度減少班次，並將運能轉至其他需求較高的國內航線。
此外，立榮航空亦向民航局申請停止營運台北至花蓮航線，目前民航局尚在評估審查中。根據民航局統計，2023年至2025年間，台北至花蓮航線載客率僅36%，高雄至花蓮為37%，台中至花蓮為44%，三條航線載客率均不及五成。

en.title: CAA Permits Mandarin Airlines Flight Cuts to Hualien as UNI Air Suspension Reviewed
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air applied to suspend Hualien flights; CAA approved flight reductions for Mandarin.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on August 27, 2026, that it has responded to an application from Mandarin Airlines to suspend its Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien routes. After an initial review, the CAA requested additional information and asked the carrier to consider local transport needs. The CAA agreed to allow Mandarin Airlines to reduce flight frequencies when booking levels are low and reallocate capacity to domestic routes with higher demand.

Meanwhile, UNI Air has also submitted an application to the CAA to suspend its Taipei-Hualien route, which remains under evaluation. According to CAA statistics covering 2023 to 2025, load factors were 36% for Taipei-Hualien, 37% for Kaohsiung-Hualien, and 44% for Taichung-Hualien, with all three routes staying below 50%.

zh.title: 美國航空737芝加哥奧黑爾（ORD）雙輪爆胎 FAA調查兩週第5起事故
zh.summary: 美國航空一架737在芝加哥奧黑爾雙輪爆胎；FAA調查兩週內第5起輪胎事故。
body: 美國航空一架波音737客機在芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場發生雙輪爆胎事故。針對這起最新發生的客機輪胎爆裂事件，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）已經正式展開調查程序。
根據Simple Flying的報導資訊，這起美航737客機的雙輪爆胎事件，是芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場自2026年8月13日以來發生的第5起輪胎失效事故。在短短兩週時間內，該機場已累積發生5起輪胎損壞相關事件。
目前美國聯邦航空總署正在調查整起事故的具體情況。主管機關將針對美航737客機雙輪爆胎及奧黑爾機場近期發生的多起輪胎失效事件進行調查與瞭解。

en.title: FAA Investigates American Airlines 737 Double Tire Blowout At Chicago O'Hare (ORD)
en.summary: FAA investigates after American Airlines 737 suffers double tire blowout in fifth O'Hare incident since August 13.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is currently investigating a safety incident after an American Airlines 737 aircraft suffered a double tire blowout at Chicago O'Hare International Airport.

According to reporting published by Simple Flying, the double blowout on the American Airlines jet represents the fifth tire-related failure reported at Chicago O'Hare since August 13. The airport has documented five separate tire incidents over the course of two weeks.

Federal aviation authorities are examining the causes and circumstances of the American Airlines 737 double blowout as part of their broader investigation into the recent cluster of tire failures at Chicago O'Hare.

zh.title: 考試院通過民航等特考增列62名額 民航特考總計44名
zh.summary: 考試院通過115年特考增列62名額；民航特考增至44名；預計9月5日起舉行。
body: 考試院院會於2026年8月27日審議通過，民國115年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員、民航人員與原住民族考試，將增列需用名額共計62名。連同先前已公告的需用名額，上述三項特種考試的總需用名額將提升至313名。
本次增列名額係因應外交部、交通部民用航空局及原住民族委員會等用人機關之業務需求提報。其中民航人員特考增列2名需用名額，使民航人員特考總需用名額達到44名。此外，三項特種考試預計將於9月5日起舉行。

en.title: Taiwan Examination Yuan Adds 62 Quotas for 2026 Civil Service Exams Including Aviation
en.summary: Taiwan Examination Yuan adds 62 civil service exam quotas; Civil Aeronautics quota reaches 44.
body: The Examination Yuan of Taiwan passed a decision on August 27, 2026, to add 62 recruitment quotas for three specialized civil service examinations, including foreign affairs personnel, civil aeronautics personnel, and indigenous peoples examinations. The total quota across these three exams has increased to 313 positions.

The adjustment responds to staffing needs submitted by government agencies, including the Civil Aeronautics Administration of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications. Specifically, two additional quotas were approved for the civil aeronautics examination, raising its overall recruitment quota to 44 positions. All three examinations are scheduled to begin on September 5.

zh.title: 澳洲航空提前4年淘汰空中巴士A380客機 首批2028年退役
zh.summary: 澳洲航空調整客機退役規劃；空中巴士A380首批將於2028年退役
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，澳大利亞國家航空澳洲航空（Qantas）調整機隊退役時程，將空中巴士 A380 巨無霸客機的退役計畫提前 4 年。根據最新的機隊規劃，首批空中巴士 A380 客機預計將於 2028 年正式離開機隊並退出服務。
根據過往的紀錄顯示，澳洲航空先前已排定於 10 月 24 日執行從墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 航班。在該條長程航線上，該航空公司選擇改為調派波音 787-9 客機接替營運。

en.title: Qantas Brings Forward Airbus A380 Retirement By Four Years To 2028
en.summary: Qantas moves up its Airbus A380 retirement schedule by four years, exiting the first superjumbos in 2028.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, Australia's flag carrier Qantas has officially moved up its timeline for retiring the Airbus A380 superjumbo fleet by four years. Under the updated operational roadmap, the carrier plans for the first of these long-haul double-deck aircraft to exit its active fleet in 2028.

This adjustment builds on prior network fleet decisions made by the airline. Historical records show that Qantas scheduled its final Airbus A380 flight between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24, while opting to utilize Boeing 787-9 widebody aircraft for that route instead.

zh.title: 神盾集團參展國際半導體展 展示AI智慧無人機技術
zh.summary: 神盾集團將於9月2日參展半導體展；旗下迅杰科技展示AI智慧無人機應用
body: 國際半導體展（SEMICON Taiwan 2026）將於2026年9月2日登場，神盾集團宣佈將再度參展，並以無人機與機器人技術作為本次展出重點。旗下迅杰科技將以AI智慧無人機為展示主軸，呈現半導體晶片技術於實際飛行領域的應用。
迅杰科技表示，其AI軟體透過模擬環境訓練World Model，並結合三軸增穩雲台相機模組，賦予無人機環境感知與自主任務規劃能力。系統同時整合衛星IoT Dongle，支援雙向衛星通訊與多星系GNSS定位，提供遠距離訊息傳輸，拓展多元飛行任務場景。

en.title: Egis Group to Feature AI Smart Drones at SEMICON Taiwan 2026
en.summary: Egis Group will showcase AI smart drones and satellite communications technology at SEMICON Taiwan 2026.
body: Egis Group has announced it will participate in SEMICON Taiwan 2026 starting September 2, 2026, featuring drones and robotics as key exhibition highlights. Its subsidiary, ENE Technology, will focus on AI smart drones to demonstrate how semiconductor chip technology extends to real-world flight applications.

According to ENE Technology, its AI software trains a World Model using simulated environments and integrates with a three-axis stabilized gimbal camera module, enabling drones with environmental perception and autonomous mission planning capabilities. The system also integrates a satellite IoT dongle supporting two-way satellite communication and multi-constellation GNSS positioning for long-distance data transmission.

zh.title: 台塑新智能微藻SAF原料通過歐盟ISCC EU認證
zh.summary: 台塑新智能微藻SAF原料獲歐盟ISCC認證；助力2030年國籍航空減碳目標
body: 台塑集團旗下台塑新智能於2026年8月27日宣布，其透過轉投資公司澄灝科技以微藻技術開發之國產永續航空燃油（SAF）新興原料，已正式取得歐盟認可的ISCC EU國際永續性與碳驗證。這項驗證展現了相關原料在永續性標準與供應鏈可追溯管理機制上的合規能力，為台灣發展自主永續航空燃油原料供應鏈奠定重要基礎。
根據台塑新智能說明，本次通過的ISCC EU驗證範圍涵蓋微藻培育與藻油製造，並完整納入溫室氣體排放計算及相關管理機制之審查。台塑新智能暨台塑生醫董事長王瑞瑜指出，ISCC EU為歐盟認可之國際永續驗證制度，亦是再生燃料原料進入歐洲永續航空燃油供應鏈的關鍵機制，未來將持續推進製程放大、提升生產效率與優化成本，由試製階段逐步邁向中試與量產驗證。
在微藻技術開發進程方面，台塑新智能總經理劉慧啟表示，澄灝科技已成功開發高效率產油藻株與異營發酵量產技術，結合自有培養條件與工業級模組化設計，藻體含油量可達到50%至60%。目前其設置之500公升試製線已完成階段性量產配方與穩定性評估，產製之藻油產品符合下游煉製端相關原料規格，顯示微藻技術已具備實際進入SAF煉製應用的技術基礎。
此外，台塑集團刻正採取雙軌並行的策略建立自主生質原料供應體系。其中台塑生醫將回收廢食用油提煉為SAF原料，台塑新智能則聚焦以微藻技術開發在地生產之生質原料，兩者分別由資源循環與新興生質技術切入以互相補充。這項布局亦呼應台灣設定之政策目標，預計在2030年實現國籍航空永續航空燃油使用量達到5%的規劃，為航空業淨零轉型提供多元選擇。

en.title: Formosa Smart Energy Algae Oil Wins ISCC EU Certification for SAF
en.summary: Formosa Smart Energy secures ISCC EU certification for microalgae oil to support Taiwan SAF goals.
body: Formosa Smart Energy, a subsidiary of Formosa Group, announced on August 27, 2026, that its microalgae-based sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) feedstock developed through its invested company, Chenghao Technology, has officially obtained ISCC EU international sustainability and carbon certification. The certification demonstrates the feedstock's compliance with international sustainability standards and supply chain traceability management, marking a key milestone in developing domestic SAF raw material supply capacity in Taiwan.

The scope of the newly acquired ISCC EU certification covers the complete process of microalgae cultivation and algae oil manufacturing, while incorporating greenhouse gas emission calculations and related management system verification. Wang Jui-yu, chairman of Formosa Smart Energy and Formosa Biomedical, stated that ISCC EU is an EU-recognized certification system and a critical verification mechanism for renewable fuel feedstocks entering the European SAF supply chain. Future efforts will focus on scaling up processes, improving production efficiency, and optimizing costs to transition from pilot production to demonstration and commercial mass verification.

Addressing technical scalability, Liu Hui-chi, general manager of Formosa Smart Energy, noted that Chenghao Technology has developed high-efficiency oil-producing algae strains alongside heterotrophic fermentation mass-production technology. Utilizing proprietary cultivation conditions and industrial modular design, the microalgae oil content reaches 50% to 60%. A 500-liter pilot line has completed phase-based mass-production formulation and stability evaluations, with the produced algae oil meeting downstream refining feedstock specifications for practical SAF refining applications.

To build an autonomous and resilient SAF raw material supply system, Formosa Group is executing a dual-track strategy where Formosa Biomedical refines recycled used cooking oil into SAF feedstock while Formosa Smart Energy develops locally produced microalgae biomass. This dual approach aligns with Taiwan's policy goal of achieving 5% SAF usage among national carriers by 2030, offering diversified choices to support the aviation industry's net-zero transition.
